title: Jeff Dean and other top AI researchers are leaving Google to launch their own startup
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: The legendary Google executive is joined by other outgoing Google execs in a joint mission to use AI to push forward the process of scientific discovery.
body:
A significant shift in the AI landscape is underway as Jeff Dean, a long-standing and highly influential executive at Google, along with several other top-tier researchers including Sanjay Ghemawat, Quoc Le, and Oriol Vinyals, are departing the tech giant. This formidable team is launching Discovery Loop, a new public benefit corporation with Dean reportedly at the helm as CEO. The startup has already secured substantial initial funding, notably from Google's parent company Alphabet, with Radical Ventures and Khosla Ventures co-leading the round, signaling strong confidence in their ambitious vision.

Discovery Loop's core mission is to revolutionize scientific research by leveraging advanced AI to automate and dramatically accelerate the discovery process. The company plans to deploy sophisticated algorithms capable of initiating and iterating thousands of experiments concurrently, aiming to partially automate research workflows and vastly expand the scale of experimentation. Crucially, they are also exploring recursive self-improvement, where AI helps create more powerful AI, potentially removing human iteration entirely from the development cycle. This endeavor matters immensely to developers and researchers as it seeks to overcome the traditional bottleneck of slow, sequential human-led iterations, promising to fundamentally transform the speed and efficiency of innovation across scientific and engineering domains.
